title: Annexin-Membrane Interactions Across Eukaryotic Domains of Life- a Comparative Approach
content: This review explores the interaction of annexins with membranes across variety of eukaryotic domains of life, highlighting this protein family's role in cellular processes due to their lipid and calcium-binding properties. By comparing annexin functions in diverse organisms, we aim to uncover novel insights into their mechanisms of action, particularly in membrane repair, protein trafficking, and potential channel formation. Despite extensive research on mammalian and plant annexins, there is limited information on annexins in invertebrates, fungi, and protists. This review seeks to bridge this knowledge gap, providing a comprehensive understanding of annexin-membrane interactions and their potential implications for cellular function and disease mechanisms across eukaryotic lineages.
